name: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Logan / Draper / Herriman) Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Logan, Draper, Herriman & Utah)
whyItWorks: One of the best fast-casual Crohn's meals in Utah: chargrilled boneless teriyaki chicken or slow-roasted Kalua pork served over two scoops of sticky steamed white rice—zero fiber, zero dairy, zero citrus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Regular or Mini Plate with Teriyaki Chicken (or Kalua Pig) and ask for "All White Rice" (two scoops of white rice instead of mayonnaise macaroni salad).
watchOuts: Sub extra white rice in place of the heavy mayo macaroni salad during flares
